answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 843 Country: Canada Title: Respected Ulama of Deoband, What was the name of the first son of Hadrat Is-haq (Alaihis salaam)? Question: Respected Ulama of Deoband, What was the name of the first son of Hadrat Is-haq (Alaihis salaam)?Jazakallah khairan Wassalaamu Alaikum. Answer ID: 843 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 255=247/D) The name of the first son of Hazrat Isshaq (Alaihis Salaam) was: عیص (Ais), who was son-in-law of Hazrat Ismael (Alaihis Salaam). For details, please see: المنتظم فی تاریخ الامم والملوک، ج1، ص 308 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
